question: Chhau is a major dance tradition of India. In which of the following Indian states is the dance form NOT prevalent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhau** is a major dance tradition in India.
 
• The dance form is prevalent in the states of **Odisha, West Bengal, and Jharkhand.**
 
• **Chhau** is not prevalent in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• Chhau dance is known for its vibrant costumes and elaborate masks, depicting various mythological and folk themes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Chhau dance** has been recognized by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage.
 
• It is traditionally performed during the spring festival, particularly **Chaitra Parva**.
 
• There are three main styles of Chhau dance named after the location where they are performed: **Purulia Chhau** (West Bengal), **Seraikella Chhau** (Jharkhand), and **Mayurbhanj Chhau** (Odisha).
 
• The dance involves martial, folk, and tribal elements, making it a unique blend of various cultural aspects.
